7.10 Escape Velocity When an object is thrown upwards, it eventually returns to the Earth due to gravity. If the initial velocity of projection is increased, the object will ascend to greater heights before eventually falling back to the Earth. By repeating this process with increasing velocity, there comes a point where the projected body just escapes the gravitational pull of the Earth (or planet). This velocity is known as the escape velocity.
